rules: Fixed sensitivity specifications registered before fitting; do not select a causal model by sign or significance
Response: cumulative percent M1 stock change from t-1 through t+h per percentage point quarterly-average T-bill rate change
Lag controls contain two lags of rate change, money growth, real GDP growth and inflation; current-controls variant adds contemporaneous GDP growth and inflation
HAC is conditional projection uncertainty; private policy information, aggregation and structural stability are not established
Public result is a dynamic financial association/design sensitivity, not an identified bank deposit-price intervention; central bank-product coverage uses the registered synthetic mechanism
